title: Form and submit the bounded client multipart request

gates.name: Realtime client/server integration
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/promo/test_realtime_attempt_api.py

verify.summary: Transitive dependency TASK-050-T2-FT-003-W3 is blocked by TASK-046-T3-FT-003-W2; TASK-052 cannot be promoted or executed through the blocked trigger/sensor path.

evidence_required: FT-003-AC-015 RED: the ready pipeline emits no request; GREEN: one ready series produces exactly one synchronous multipart/form-data POST whose manifest v1 contains only allowed identity/timing/camera/occurrence fields, one crop_NNN image/jpeg part per first-at-most-20 occurrence in ascending order, manifest only for zero occurrences, current configured JPEG quality, and the manually retained display token only in Authorization; deterministic fixture marker values are serialized through a clock-input seam without implementing marker collection; decisive comparison: captured browser requests are diffed against field/omission/part/credential rules and pass the completed real server boundary as integration delta; artifact: Playwright transcript and request captures under .tasks/TASK-052-T2-FT-003-W4/.
purpose: Own browser multipart serialization and one-request submission while consuming server admission and clock-marker seams as dependencies.
success_outcome: The real client forms one exact bounded request for ordinary and zero-occurrence series and the completed server admits it.
anti_goals: Do not implement server validation/admission or client clock-marker collection.
Do not implement outcome branching, notices or retry.
Do not add ranking, client truncation or forbidden manifest fields.

forbidden_scope: One-clock marker collection owned by TASK-066-T2-FT-003-W5
Outcomes/notices owned by TASK-053 and TASK-067
stop_conditions: A compliant client request cannot pass the accepted real endpoint.
Required correlation cannot stay within the manifest allow-list.

constraints: Use installed playwright cli against the real client and central endpoint with disposable profile/state.
Serialize deterministic caller-supplied timing values here; TASK-066 owns collection and monotonic reconciliation.
Store token only in managed profile and Authorization header; retain redacted request captures.
invariants: Exactly one synchronous request is sent per ready series.
Manifest/parts obey exact allow-list, names and order.
Server admission and clock-marker claims remain with TASK-045 and TASK-066.
verification_targets: FT-003-AC-015 browser request captures for >20, ordinary and zero occurrences.
Integration delta proves the completed server accepts the client-formed request without re-owning AC-006.
Redaction scan proves Authorization-only display token placement.
